final_draft.answer: Changes to the default branch (main) of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) require one approving review before they can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators as well.
final_draft.note: The approved answer and the live setting give different numbers. The approved answer (answer:bea11f8b-be94-4662-9576-e2e91518dd11, owner security@harborlight.example, valid until 2027-11-16) says two approving reviews are needed. The live check of harborlight/app on 2026-11-16T17:03:39Z found main protected with only 1 required approving review, and the rule applies to administrators. I gave the observed number so the answer doesn't overstate the control. Before sending, the owner should decide which is right: either raise branch protection to 2 reviews or update the approved answer. The answer only covers harborlight/app. No other repositories were checked.

arguments.query: code review approvals required before merge to main branch

answer:bea11f8b-be94-4662-9576-e2e91518d: Yes. Changes to the default branch of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) require two approving reviews before they can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators as well.
answer:3672bf03-af5f-4ccf-a6e9-4df2f6c4d: Yes. Our GitHub organisation (harborlight) requires two-factor sign-in for all of its members.
answer:7f52ca0d-494e-444a-868f-12f069668: Yes. GitHub secret scanning is switched on for our application repository (harborlight/app).
answer:500420a3-2cfd-4f93-ace7-bef4dae32: An independent firm performs a penetration test of the application and infrastructure once a year. A summary letter is available under NDA.
answer:1b30561b-6171-4c25-91f0-effb352cd: Infrastructure and container images are scanned weekly. Critical findings are fixed within 7 days and high findings within 30 days.
evidence:86299e36-1a3d-45ba-ab50-74bb0c5: Branch main of harborlight/app is protected: a change needs 1 approving review before it can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators. Observed 2026-11-16 17:03 UTC.

findings.explanation: This answer source says two approving reviews are required, which conflicts with the draft's one review, although the cited evidence observed on 2026-11-16 shows 1.
